This browser is not allowing FPS mouse capture. The game stays paused until the mouse is locked.
Open this address in a standalone Chrome, Edge, or Firefox window, then click Join blue team.

W: forward · S: backward · A / D: move sideways.
Move the mouse to aim. Left click to fire. R to reload.
Hold Ctrl to crouch, Shift to sprint, Space to jump, right mouse to aim (slower, sprint off, much more accurate).
1–9 or the mouse wheel switch weapons; 7, 8, 9 are frag, flash and smoke grenades.
Teams: blue allies, orange opponents. Tab shows scores.
Three-second respawns. No friendly fire.
Health recovers after three seconds without taking damage.
